summary.name: C2Anime
summary.one_liner: C2Anime is a browser-based AI studio that turns a story, script, or idea into a planned, voiced anime-style video with reusable characters.
keywords: ai video with dialogue and sound
use_cases: turn a short story into an anime video
adapt a novel or literary story into animation
plan a screenplay and storyboard before rendering
make an animated short with voices and music
create a recurring cast for a series of animated scenes
summary.what_it_does: C2Anime takes a pasted story, idea, script, or novel and uses an AI Film Director to draft a screenplay the user can review. Users then choose an anime look, build a cast with reusable character, location, and prop references, and review the storyboard and shots. Scenes are rendered into video with narration, dialogue, ambient sound, and music, and the result can be exported. The page shows example films in landscape and portrait, including adaptations of O. Henry, W. W. Jacobs, and Saki. The workflow runs entirely in the browser, and the user can test the first scene before rendering the rest.
notable: AI Film Director plans screenplay, cast, storyboard, and shots from a story
Reusable character, location, and prop references for consistency across scenes
Runs in the browser with no Blender, 3D modeling, or rigging required
Can test the first video scene before rendering the full film
caveats: Generation uses credits; the page refers to pricing plans without listing specifics
Results depend on scenes and generation settings; the page notes examples are actual outputs but not guaranteed results
Listing tags the tool as paid
